title: Pack for a trip
subtitle: A list that fits the weather and your plans
description: Say where you’re going, when and what you’ll do. Your Sylo checks the forecast, remembers how you like to travel, and gives you a short checklist: documents, clothes counted to the days, and what the weather and the plans call for. It leaves out what you can buy there.
asks: What should I pack for 4 days in Lisbon in March?
A weekend hiking in the Alps, carry-on only.
